name: Espressif ESP32-C6 (RISC-V, Wi-Fi 6, 802.15.4)

flash_psram_gpio.notes: GPIO24-30 are the SPI flash bus on modules/in-package flash; not broken out on DevKitC-1.

adc2_wifi_conflict.note: C6 has only ADC1 (GPIO0-6), so no ADC2/Wi-Fi conflict.
adc2_wifi_conflict.approx_note: From the datasheet analog table summary; verify.

caution_gpio.14: not bonded on every package (approx); avoid

notes: GPIO0/1 are XTAL_32K if a crystal is fitted; 4-7 are JTAG.

platformio.platform: espressif32 (official: ESP-IDF only for this board) or pioarduino for Arduino

chip_level.G{n}: GPIOn on many clones (but a bare 'G' is GND)
chip_level.{n}: bare number next to a header = GPIOn on Espressif DevKits
chip_level.BOOT: button on the boot strapping GPIO

board_level.D{n}: Arduino/XIAO-style digital number. NOT GPIOn on XIAO or Arduino Nano ESP32; look up the board's own map
board_level.SDA / SCL: board/framework default I2C, board-specific (ESP32 can route I2C to almost any GPIO)

never_map: D0..D3 printed next to CLK/CMD on classic ESP32 DevKitC = flash pins, NOT Arduino D0-D3

provenance.notes: Strapping GPIO4/5/8/9/15 and USB GPIO12/13 quoted from the datasheet.
